batches.prompt: A vintage casino slot machine attract sound for a survival horror video game. One short cabinet cue: soft mechanical reel whir and dry ratcheting clicks, ending in two or three bright, slightly worn electromechanical bell chimes. Starts immediately and decays cleanly within 1.5 seconds. Close, dry, isolated machine recording. No jackpot fanfare, coin shower, voices, music, crowd, ambience or reverb.

One fast melee weapon swipe for a zombie survival video game: a long wooden casino craps stick swung forcefully through air. A dry, weighty cane swoosh with a faint woody flex and thin whipping edge. Begin immediately, swell to the strongest swish around a quarter second, then stop cleanly within 0.6 seconds. One isolated swing. No hit, impact, crack, splinters, metallic blade, second swing, voice, music, ambience or reverb.
